subject: Lane D dedupe handoff: current-main/API findings before pivot
body: Manager dedupe observed; I am vacating Lane D and handing these independent findings to the assigned owners. Current main bfbf5d68: compileSdk/targetSdk 35. FoldOverlayView is a custom ViewGroup whose animating FoldView invalidates on each tilt update; Android API 35 View.setRequestedFrameRate is available, and the platform documents that a ViewGroup request does NOT automatically propagate to child Views. Therefore a View-path 120Hz vote should land on the actual redrawing FoldView (and optionally host/window), not only the parent. Android 15+ View voting defaults most Views to Normal/~60Hz unless a higher vote is made; this is a plausible explanation for remaining 60Hz cadence on the custom shader path. SurfaceControl.Transaction.setFrameRate(sc, rate, DEFAULT, ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS) is public since API31; clearFrameRate(sc) since API34; setFrameTimeline(vsyncId) since API35. WindowManager.LayoutParams.preferredRefreshRate is documented as equivalent to a seamless-only DEFAULT Surface.setFrameRate vote on API34+. Samsung documents both Fold7 cover and main displays as 1-120Hz adaptive. Current TransitionLab already has Choreographer FrameTimeline vsyncId/deadline/expected-present and transaction commit/latch/present-fence timing, so effective cadence proof can be added without new privileged plumbing. Quantization-only model: uniform event-to-next-vsync mean wait 8.33ms@60 vs 4.17ms@120; p95 15.83ms vs 7.92ms. Thus 120Hz is an incremental ~4.17ms mean scheduling lever, not by itself the campaign's >=50% latency solution. Also current TiltFollower hardcodes first dt=1/60; at 120Hz the first easing step is twice the real frame interval, so direct-vsync Gen5 should bypass it or make first-dt refresh-aware.
